class MLA_MoE_RAG(nn.Module):
  def __init__(self, mla, moe, retriever):
    self.mla = mla
    self.moe = moe
    self.retriever = retriever
  def forward(self, query):
    latent = self.mla(query)
    routed = self.moe(latent)
    docs = self.retriever.retrieve(query)
    doc_emb = self.mla(docs)
    return routed + doc_emb
